programme.title: Mutant X: The Taking of Crows
programme.desc: Når Lexa uvitende er dopet med et dødelig stoff, må teamet løpe for å finne motgiften før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Shadows of Darkness
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir kalt inn for å undersøke bisarre aktiviteter som skjer på et lokalt sykehus.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Hand of God
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet legger ut på oppdrag for å finne og fange en kraftig supermutant som har gudlignende krefter.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wasteland
programme.desc: Jesse blir tvunget til å komme i kontakt med sin tidligere forlovede når Mutant X-teamet får vite at selskapet hennes er involvert i genetisk manipulering av avlinger.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 e.Kr.: En sjeik bruker sannhetens lys for å avsløre sin general som en forræder. 2001: Prince Shareem dropper fra Sydneys klasse for å søke etter sannhetens lys.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney er på jakt etter en pirats bytte, men vil en forræder tvinge henne til å gå på planken?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney har funnet et tempel med et afgud av Ganesha, og det blir filmet for TV, men de blir fanget inne når de lokale opprørerne snubler over dem. Kan Nigel og Karen hjelpe fra USA?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: En anonym sultans kone Danielle dør under mystiske omstendigheter i ørkenen. Hun hadde imidlertid bedt Sydney om å hjelpe. Sydney mener Danielle lette etter stjernen til Nadir.

programme.title: Andromeda: Og ditt hjerte vil fly bort
programme.desc: Når en forlengst mistet kjærlighet kommer tilbake, forsvinner Tyr fra skipet for å beskytte henne mot en snikmorder.
programme.sub-title: Og ditt hjerte vil fly bort

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ukontrable mannen
programme.desc: Sett i et alternativt univers der Dylan døde og Gaheris Rhade prøver å reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som angrep Andromeda under den første undertegningen av Commonwealth-charteret, vender tilbake til mer kaos.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Dark Backward
programme.desc: Trance går gjennom noen forskjellige scenarier og prøver å finne en der mannskapet hennes ikke dør.

programme.title: Mutant X: No Exit
programme.desc: En mutant som har muligheten til å feste med hvilken som helst datamaskin med tankene sine, som er lammet etter et møte med teamet, tar over Sanctuarys datamaskiner.

programme.title: Mutant X: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet lærer om Lexas fremmede tvillingbror når han blir hovedmålet for en underjordisk operasjon som høster mutante organer.

programme.title: Mutant X: Possibilities
programme.desc: Brennan og Mutant X-teamet slår seg sammen med en tidsreisende mutant for å spre en bombe som truer ødeleggende konsekvenser.

programme.title: Mutant X: Conspiracy Theory
programme.desc: Mens Brennan og Shalimar etterforsker en mystisk flyulykke, tenker Lexa på fremtiden sin med Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Devil Doll
programme.desc: En guide fører Sydney og Nigel til et uvanlig, underjordisk aztekisk gravkammer. I stedet for en kropp finner de en relikvie.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Incognito
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel henter en mytisk lansett, og støter på Nigels likhet like før hans død. Nigel får et kutt fra lansetten. Senere overtaler Cate Nigel til å etterligne mannen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, en samler, bruker et gammelt halskjede for å få Sydney til å hjelpe henne med å oppdra Athena, som deretter vil hjelpe henne med å erobre verden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: Når Sydneys student Megs romkamerat finner en hekses amulett, innlegger det Meg. Meg's kjærestes brorskap bror løper for å få amuletten. Hva gjør han?

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Chef Ramsay announces that he is taking his risotto off of the Hell's Kitchen menu, and the contestants are tasked with preparing their own risotto dish in the hopes of replacing the old one for the remainder of the season.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: All 15 chefs walk into a dining room filled with Marines, where they find out they will have to cook dishes that represent the air, land and sea. Things take a drastic turn when one chef accuses Chef Ramsay of sabotaging her.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Teams are tasked with cooking halibut in seven different ways; a dinner service; an elimination; pianist Stephan Moccio; chef David LeFevre.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs must create a dish using potatoes as the key component. The pressure becomes unbearable for one chef, leading to a chaotic dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: A challenge involving cooking five commonly served 'staple' dishes. Chef Ramsay makes changes to a dining service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The final ten chefs are surprised when Ramsay brings in his daughter to celebrate her Sweet 16, each chef must create a worthy dish to be served at her party.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: For the chefs' next challenge, Chef Ramsay pits the teams against one another, preparing authentic Chinese dishes as prominent Chinese Chef Shirley Chung is brought in to judge their finished dishes.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: With the dining room transformed into an Italian bistro, all eight chefs learn that they will participate in the beloved blind taste test challenge, gelato edition. With two tables of 12 patrons, the chefs rush to see who finishes first.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The seven remaining chefs are called down to the dining room to discover two ice dancers performing a routine. Chef Ramsay explains ice dancing can be romantic, just as dessert can be. For their challenge they must cook an extraordinary dessert.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the final six chefs break through a case, retrieving a random ingredient they will have to cook with. The second challenge has each chef cooking with the same four ingredients. The third challenge is a surf and turf challenge.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The five chefs compete in Chef Ramsay's Taste It, Now Make It challenge, recreating his intricate eggs Benedict dish. Later, the fish station struggles at dinner service, leaving the chef in charge of it in real danger of being sent home.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs undertake a tableside challenge, creating dishes for esteemed brigades acting as judges. Later, elimination surprises everyone, including Chef Ramsay.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Following emotional reunions with their proud parents, Chef Ramsay tasks the final two chefs with creating five meals in only 60 minutes, with the winner earning first pick for their brigade in the final challenge.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs go head-to-head for the final time, before the new executive chef at Gordon Ramsay's Hell's Kitchen at Caesar's Palace is announced.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Eighteen aspiring chefs from across the country, 23-years-old or younger, begin the competition.
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Young Guns Come Out Shooting

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Both teams are put to the test as they take on their first dinner service preparing dinner for boxing legend Mike Tyson and racecar driver Kurt Busch.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs must replicate the very first challenge in "Hell's Kitchen" history: breaking down squid perfectly for chef Ramsay; Gordon discovers the blue team has served up raw chicken during dinner service.
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Come Hell or High Water!

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs must make brunch for 60 hungry Caesars Palace employees, fresh off the night shift; one chef takes the fall during the use of a punishment pass, earning the respect of both teams; dinner service leads some chefs to crack under the pressure.
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: Young Guns Going Big

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: After a big shakeup during the last elimination, both teams must work together to decipher recipes written in emojis; one team has its best dinner service performance yet, while the other team struggles to find its groove.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs take on a new type of challenge when the restaurant is closed for chef Ramsay's daughter's 21st birthday party; one team rises to the occasion, while the other serves up its biggest disappointment thus far.
programme.sub-title: Young Guns: A Ramsay Birthday in Hell!

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson og James May kappkjører med en bil og en superyacht i et nervepirrende løp langs den vakre kysten av New Zealand helt opp til spissen av Nordøya.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson tester den sensasjonelle Ferrari F12 med 730 hestekrefter i det vidåpne landskapet i Skottland. Richard Hammond kombinerer motorsport og drosjer.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James reiser til Spania med tre "rimelige" kabrioleter: en McLaren 12C Spider, en Ferrari 458 Spider og en Audi R8 V10 Spyder.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond og James May hjelper flomrammede Storbritannia ved å bygge en luftputebil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson og James May ser nærmere på en stadig mer populær type høye småbiler som ofte kalles "crossover".

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Teamet gjennomgår en rekke utfordringer for å bevise at småbilene var bedre i deres ungdom enn de er nå.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Richard tester en spennende, ny Alfa Romeo langs bredden av Comosjøen - mot Jeremy, som kjører en firehjuls ATV.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy feirer lanseringen av en ny Alfa Romeo i Italia, og Richard kjører en Mercedes Benz G63 6x6 i Abu Dhabi.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy og James får i oppdrag å filme en informasjonsfilm om trygg sykling og må presentere den for et ekspertpanel.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Gutta kjører tre billige lastebiler som knapt vil gå på tvers av Burma, et land som for det meste har vært stengt for vestlige besøkende i mange år.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: Gutta er i Russland og kappkjører på tvers av det enorme og svært vakre urbane landskapet i St. Petersburg.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond og James May legger ut på en fantastisk road trip på tvers av Australias Northern Territory.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Teamet prøver å finne nye kjøretøyer som skal erstatte og forbedre eksisterende ambulanser, før de må gjennomgå en rekke utfordringer.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Jeremy tester en BMW M4, James kjører en Mercedes AMG GT med 500 bremsehestekrefter, og Richard lager en nervepirrende hyllest til en Land Rover.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Jeremy og James tar en nostalgisk titt på Peugeot, og Richard tester en Corvette mot den nye Porsche Cayman GTS.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Richard Hammond blir etterlatt i villmarken i Canada for å teste en klokke med en innebygd nødsender.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Opprørskjøttet
programme.desc: En soltsunami gjør at TARDIS havner i en fabrikk der menneskelige dobbeltgjengere må jobbe med farlig syre.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Nestenfolket
programme.desc: Mens solstormen raser blir en gjenger gal av minnene om å bli satt ut av drift og søker hevn.

programme.title: Doctor Who: En god mann drar ut i krig
programme.desc: Doktoren trenger en hær, men mens han krever inn gjentjenester over hele universet, venter en felle på ham.
programme.sub-title: En god mann drar ut i krig

programme.title: Doctor Who: La oss drepe Hitler
programme.desc: I jakten på Melody Pond lander TARDIS i Berlin på 1930-tallet.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Nattskrekk
programme.desc: Doktoren mottar et nødrop fra det skumleste stedet i universet – et barns soverom.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Jenta som ventet
programme.desc: Amy er fanget i et karanteneanlegg for ofrene for en utenomjordisk pest.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Gudskomplekset
programme.desc: TARDIS lander på et hotell der hvert rom inneholder en gjests mørkeste redsler. Hva venter i Doktorens rom?

programme.title: Doctor Who: Stengetid
programme.desc: I de siste dagene av sitt liv besøker Doktoren en gammel venn for å si farvel, og møter også en gammel fiende.

programme.title: Doctor Who: River Songs bryllup
programme.desc: Doktoren legger ut på sin siste ferd og vet at bare én ting kan redde universet – hans egen død.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Dalekenes asyl
programme.desc: Doktoren blir kidnappet av sin eldste fiende og tvinges med på et umulig oppdrag.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Dinosaurer på et romskip
programme.desc: Et ubemannet romskip er i ferd med å styrte og tilintetgjøres sammen med sin umulige last – dinosaurer!

programme.title: Doctor Who: En by ved navn Mercy
programme.desc: Doktoren får en Stetson-hatt (og en pistol!) og blir motvillig sheriff i en by i det ville vesten.

programme.title: Doctor Who: De mektige tre
programme.desc: Doktoren, Amy og Rory står overfor en merkelig invasjon når millioner av svarte terninger dukker opp.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Englene inntar Manhattan
programme.desc: Doktoren, Amy og Rory må kjempe mot klokka når statuene i New York våkner til live rundt dem.

programme.title: Doctor Who: St. Johns klokker
programme.desc: Doktorens leting etter Clara Oswald bringer ham til dagens London, der noe lurer i wifi-signalene.

programme.title: Melrose Place: God kveld, Mr. Campbell, del 1
programme.desc: Da Amanda blir bortført og det kreves $1 000 000 i løsepenger, tilbyr Peter seg å hjelpe Kyle med å få henne trygt tilbake.

programme.title: Melrose Place: God kveld, Mr. Campbell, del 2
programme.desc: Etter å ha levert løsepengene tar Peter rollen som Amandas helt. Men hun flykter fra hytta og blir forfulgt av en av kidnapperne.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Verden ifølge Matt
programme.desc: Megan begjærer plutselig Michael igjen etter at Cooper drar til Philadelphia. Men Michael har andre planer, og frir til Jane.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Der horene gror
programme.desc: Michael følger Megan til hennes tidligere hjem på en hesteranch og treffer hennes mor og invalide far.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Doktor sjalusi
programme.desc: Etter en slåsskamp med Alex bestemmer Michael seg for å teste Janes trofasthet. Megan begynner å jobbe for Lexis byrå.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ikke alt om Eve
programme.desc: Lexi blir med Megan på middag med Ryan og skremmer Amanda med sin forretningssans. Samtidig prøver Ryan å finne ut av Lexis planer.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ryktehviskeren
programme.desc: Etter en krangel tilstår Michael troskapstesten for Jane, som gir ham et ultimatum: Han må slutte å spionere på henne, ellers blir det ikke noe bryllup.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Kvelden lyset gikk i Melrose
programme.desc: Jane flytter midlertidig inn i Melrose-komplekset igjen, og Michael følger med på henne mens hun går med på å bli modell for Alex.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Mistanke
programme.desc: Amanda sender Jane til Chicago for å hjelpe Alex med å forbli kunde hos Amanda Woodward Advertising. Jane sverger på at det bare er forretninger.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Spilling på taket
programme.desc: På Michael og Janes bryllupsdag prøver den utspekulerte Lexi å holde Ryan unna seremonien, og Jane får dårlig samvittighet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Dødellig bryllup 4
programme.desc: Peter og Eve drar til Peters hjemby etter at faren hans dør. Peter revurderer livet sitt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Når heiagjenger angriper
programme.desc: Kyle får vite om forholdet mellom Eve og Amanda da de forteller om kvelden de slo seg sammen mot Eves voldelige kjæreste.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Plutselig sæd
programme.desc: Michaels eiendomsmegler forfører ham da han vil selge strandhuset. Samtidig tenker Jane på sitt første møte med Michael.

programme.title: Melrose Place: De vanlige julenissene
programme.desc: Juleferien begynner dårlig for alle da Peter, Michael, Kyle, Ryan og Louis Vicontti forveksles med en gruppe bankranere.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Kyle-klubben
programme.desc: Med hjelp fra Megan bestemmer Lexi seg for å bruke sin forretningssans til å finne et forhold. Jane og Michael belastes med advokatsalærer.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Gift med en morder
programme.desc: Michael må bruke av Wilshires finanser for å investere i Perrys lyssky forretninger, men ender opp med å angre på det.

programme.title: Melrose Place: For en neve hemmeligheter
programme.desc: Etter et tips fra en full Kyle om Eves fortid, reiser Peter til hennes hjemby i Oakdale for å etterforske.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den yngre sønnen
programme.desc: Valentinsdagen nærmer seg, og Kyle og Ryans dominerende og militante far Mack kommer til byen til Kyles bursdag.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Redd Ryan
programme.desc: Kyle forsvinner etter å ha tent på sitt og Amandas fremtidige hjem. Han avslører en overraskende hemmelighet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Å skyte løskrutt
programme.desc: Amanda besøker Kyle, som nå er på rehabklinikk, men det går ikke bra. Senere oppstår rykter om Amanda og Peter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mirakel i Middle Creek
programme.desc: En seksåring faller ned i et 12 meter dypt avløp, og Walker prøver å redde ham. Men når hullet raser sammen, blir Walker og gutten sittende fast uten mye til håp.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Æresgalleriet
programme.desc: Kvelden før C.D. skal innlemmes i Texas Rangers’ Æresgalleri hjemsøker en seriemorder fra en 11 år gammel sak ham, og han begynner å tvile på om han fortjener æren.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Høyere makter
programme.desc: Walker prøver å holde en familie samlet etter at en tibetansk munk oppdager at ånden til Lama Dolgin har blitt reinkarnert som en ung gutt og prøver å ta gutten med til Tibet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Patriot
programme.desc: Når Walker og Trivette arresterer lederen for en høyreekstrem gruppe, hevner gruppen seg ved å ta Alex og de ansatte ved en minoritetseid TV-stasjon som gissel.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Spøkelsesrytteren
programme.desc: Når byggarbeidere avdekker en ung indianergutts forråtnede lik, prøver Walker og Trivette å løse en gammel forbrytelse. Men når ingen i byen vil snakke, har de bare skjelettet å gå ut fra.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Brorskap
programme.desc: Et hevnlystent politibrorskap begynner å drepe skurker som slippes fri, og Walker må gjøre slutt på terroren.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pest
programme.desc: Walker må redde livet til sine venner på Cherokee-reservatet når de settes i fare av et selskap som driver et eksperimentelt meieri og velger fremtidig profitt fremfor sikkerhet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Forløsning
programme.desc: Det er Cahill mot Cahill når sjefen for en forbryterliga hyrer Alex sin alkoholiserte far, Gordon Cahill, som forsvarsadvokat.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kodenavn: Dragonfly
programme.desc: Walkers nemesis fra Vietnam-tiden stjeler et hemmelig militærhelikopter for å smugle dop for kartellene, og Walker får sjansen til å rydde opp i gatene og gjøre opp for fortiden.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et stille rop
programme.desc: Darcy Reynolds, datteren til Walkers venn, voldtas etter at drinken hennes blir dopet på 21-årsdagen hennes. Walker leter etter overfallsmennene på nattklubbene i Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svanesang
programme.desc: Når et styrtet fly som ble brukt i et bankran og drapet på Walkers venn åtte år tidligere oppdages i Utahs fjell, drar Walker dit for å prøve å løse saken.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Syklon
programme.desc: Alex og C.D. følger en gruppe barn hjem etter "Barn i regjeringen" når de tas som gisler av kidnappere som begraver bussen deres i gjørme, og Walker må redde dem før en syklon når dem.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lucky
programme.desc: To eiendomsutviklere dreper en prest for å hindre byggingen av et jobbsenter for hjemløse. Det fins bare to øyenvitner: en hjemløs mann som har forsvunnet og hunden Lucky som hjelper Walker.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Den dødeligste mannen i live
programme.desc: Verdens dødeligste leiemorder, som kan ha vært involvert i drapet på JFK, har blitt funnet i Dallas, og Walker må gjøre slutt på terroren før Israels ambassadør blir hans neste offer.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: En rangers jul
programme.desc: En julefest for foreldreløse barn på C.D.’s blir scenen for Walkers fortelling, en rangers versjon av Charles Dickens’ "En julefortelling".

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mayday
programme.desc: Walker og Charlie Brooks, et nøkkelvitne han eskorterer, overlever mirakuløst når flyet deres sprenges over Utah. Walker må lede de overlevende, inkludert en kvinne i barsel, til sikkerhet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Siste håp
programme.desc: Walker, Alex, C.D. og Trivette tar en gruppe barn med på Ranger-leir for en helg, uten å vite at en av guttene har stjålet penger fra doplangere og satt dem alle i fare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Full kontakt
programme.desc: Når Johnny Prado, en kickboksingmester, klandres av en fiende for drapet på manageren/treneren sin og dopbesittelse, tar Walker over som treneren hans for verdensmesterskapet i kickboksing.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Den 99. ranger
programme.desc: Walker hjelper en kvinne å realisere drømmen om å bli en Texas Ranger.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Djevelens territorium
programme.desc: Elever på videregående begynner å dø av ulykker forbundet med «powerballs», en kombinasjon av anabole steroider og metamfetaminer, blir Walker vikarlærer for å finne kulden til dopet.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh er i trening for å bli en iskald internasjonal leiemorder, men i hemmelighet lengter hun etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Bryan Mills og hans kone er i Istanbul når de blir bortført. Mannen som holder dem som gissel viser seg å være far til en av de mennene som tidligere kidnappet Mills datter, og under frigjøringen av datteren ble han drept.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 1
programme.desc: The fourth season begins six months after Kris was forced out of Raintree, which has undergone significant operational changes that leave Matt pining for the past.

programme.title: Wildfire: The More Things Change: Part 2
programme.desc: After Kris unexpectedly returns for a glimpse of Wildfire's next race, she gains an unlikely ally and a place to stay.

programme.title: Wildfire: Calm
programme.desc: Jean and Pablo are adamant that Kris leave town instead of sticking around and helping to care for Wildfire.

programme.title: Wildfire: Flames
programme.desc: Kris and Junior help Matt with his improbable plan to get Raintree back in the horse-racing business, which involves finding Wildfire's offspring, Flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Friend
programme.desc: Junior's preoccupation with his and Calvin's business proposition takes time away from his wedding plans, but Laura suspects his loss of focus may have something to do with Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: The pressure is on Junior to decide whether or not to go through with his wedding to Laura after he and Kris share a moment of passion.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Wildfire: Vows
programme.desc: Kris and Junior hastily decide to get married, but they're forced to postpone their plans when Jean is injured by one of the horses rescued by Matt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Comeback
programme.desc: With Jean still out of commission, Kris and Matt do their best to run the dude ranch at Raintree while also preparing for the next race, which features Dani's new horse in the field

programme.title: Wildfire: Being Mrs. Junior
programme.desc: Universal disapproval of Kris and Junior's wedding plans has everyone on edge, and even Kris wonders if she has what it takes to be part of the Davis family.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 1
programme.desc: Kris and Junior consider a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to relocate to Alaska for a year to work on a geothermal project in the series' penultimate episode.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 2
programme.desc: In the series finale, Junior's schedule goes haywire when an urgent matter in Alaska that requires his attention coincides with Kris'ride on Wildfire in the Tucker Stakes and their wedding.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger's Knock
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a house fire they discover a woman shot and killed inside. Police must unlock the mystery of who started the blaze to solve the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Rites
programme.desc: When a nun is found strangled and stabbed to death on the day before Easter, investigators are forced to look behind church walls in search of a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder by the Numbers?
programme.desc: A small town is outraged when its unofficial mayor is the victim of a vicious attack at work. The police investigation uncovers a number of possible suspects and a confusing trail of evidence but will it lead them to the person who committed the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: A Thin Disguise
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger ambushes a family as they pull into their driveway. Could the memories of a five year old girl be the key to solving the crime?

programme.title: On the Case: Bound by the Truth
programme.desc: When a retired professor is found murdered, police must figure out whether the victim's son and daughter in law were eyewitnesses or the killers.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programme.desc: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programme.title: On the Case: Sirens in the Night
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the shocking discovery of a mysterious young woman who is found in the ashes of a fire.

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Errand
programme.desc: When a young woman vanishes after stepping out to buy salad dressing, police try to provide answers to her fiancé and family.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood Money
programme.desc: After 21 years, DNA analysis of a blood-stained dollar bill helps to solve the murder of gas station clerk Bradley Perry.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Betrayal
programme.desc: A beloved father of two is executed after a friendly poker game. Were the stakes too high? Or would police find the truth much closer to home?

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery, Heartbreak and Justice
programme.desc: A look at three cases in which the quest for justice rages on after the verdict has been delivered.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Carnage
programme.desc: When 25 year old Laci Hill vanishes without a trace; police receive the key to solving the mystery from her kidnapper's wife.

programme.title: On the Case: The Ultimate Sin
programme.desc: A man's crisis of conscience unravels a decades old mystery behind a young girl's murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A new father comes home to find his infant son and wife missing. Four months later their bodies are found in a remote wooded area. When police investigate the father's past they find the reason for the unthinkable crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Silenced
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman goes missing, police are baffled.

programme.title: On the Case: Where Evil Lies
programme.desc: A 25-year-old aspiring model vanishes, and the only clue police have is her empty car found near a cemetery.

programme.title: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
programme.desc: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.

programme.title: On the Case: Unmistakable Truth
programme.desc: A family of three is murdered and investigators must take on one of their own in order to find justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Blurred Truth
programme.desc: Paula Zahn explores a chilling crime mystery involving a murdered mother of five and speaks to the individuals directly involved in the case.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner
programme.desc: When South Korean buyers come to Buffalo to look at a water bomber, the pressure is on mechanic Cory to get the plane ready. But a landing gear emergency puts him and chief pilot Justin in serious danger.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: North Atlantic Convoy
programme.desc: Greenland's Narsarsuaq airport - known as one the world's most dangerous approaches - looms on the horizon as Cory and Justin begin a trans-global journey to deliver two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Sunk
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey hire a helicopter for a salvage mission to retrieve the rare tailpiece from a Lockheed 10-A that crashed in the Yellowknife woods forty years ago.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Turkey or Bust
programme.desc: Justin and Cory are stranded in Croatia while trying to complete the delivery of two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start
programme.desc: Mikey links up with Chris Hadfield aboard the International Space Station. Problems mount while trying to get a frozen DC-4 airborne. A landing gear collapse on the runway sends the entire crew scrambling.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shootout
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot David faces a remote Arctic airstrip with sketchy landing gear. Mikey drafts a Buffalo hockey team to face off against an NHL squad in a charity shootout. Chuck gets a chance to shine on the ice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Snowplane
programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Lock
programme.desc: A cold snap triggers massive challenges. Devan runs into gear problems while he ferries a mothballed DC-3 across the country. And Justin has to make a snap decision with his newborn son aboard his plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vi Gör Ett Förekläde, Bourguignon & Pierre Jagar I Tyskland
programme.desc: Jompen tillverkar årets bästa present: läderförkläden i naturgarvat kalvskinn med remmar i ekologiskt linne. Han pryder sina kreationer med en sjukt snygg logo.
programme.sub-title: Vi Gör Ett Förekläde, Bourguignon & Pierre Jagar I Tyskland

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vårbock I Uppsala
programme.desc: Jakt är jakt pürshar råbock utanför Uppsala. Som vanligt går det inte riktigt som han tänkt sig.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Bäventyret 2.0
programme.desc: Episk bäverjakt är veckans film! Jompen bjuder med hans polare Simon på glamping. Det blir glamping med taktält, bålpannor och husbil men ännu bättre jakt!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Rabbisjakt & Jakten på den gamla skovelhjorten
programme.desc: Vi hänger på Gotland och jagar efter rabbisar och god mat.
programme.sub-title: Rabbisjakt & Jakten på den gamla skovelhjorten

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Björnjakt I Fjällen
programme.desc: Filip ger sig iväg i fjällen på björnjakt. En utmanande och tidskrävande jaktform som väldigt snabbt kan få upp pulsen när björnarna väl dyker upp!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Älgjakt I Medstugan
programme.desc: Pierre åker till Jämtland och jagar älg med Johan Persson på Fjelljakt. De tar helikoptern ut på fjället och jagar älg i riktig vildmark på fjället med löshund.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Tullgarn
programme.desc: Jompen och Pierre är på Tullgarn och spanar efter nyheter. Dom tittar på kikarsikten, vapen och andra intressant prylar.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Pyrschjakt På Dovhjort & Rävjakt
programme.desc: Lubbe och teamet ska ut och pürscha dovhjort, men teamets ovana vid skog och mark sätter återigen käppar i hjulet.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Julspecial
programme.desc: Vi är i Blommeröd hos Calle och jagar och lagar julmat på vilt.

programme.title: Vilterian: Rådjursrostbiff
programme.desc: Lågtempererad Rådjursrostbiff med potatiskaka och ädelostsås lagas. Proteinet kan såklart ersättas med vad du än känner passar!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Dovpyrsch Special
programme.desc: Danne & Jompen är tillbaka på den årliga Wibyholms-pyrschen! Två dagars grym Dovpyrsch på viltrika marker.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Grilla Vildsvin
programme.desc: Jompen, Pierre och Salong Betong-Danne ska laga vildsvinskebab till Dannes fru som fyller år. Det enda som saknas är vildsvinet. Jakt efter vildsvinet har börjat......

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Skogsfågel I Norge & Stoffe Och Aska Jagar Skogsfågel
programme.desc: Jompen och Danne ger sig ut på en utmanande skogsfågeljakt utanför Elverum i Norge.
programme.sub-title: Skogsfågel I Norge & Stoffe Och Aska Jagar Skogsfågel

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Harjakt & Sista Drevjakten För Året
programme.desc: Jakt på hare. Lubbe och Jompen irrar omkring i skogen och försöker lista ut var hararna finns.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vildsvinsjakt I Skärgården
programme.desc: Jompen är tillbaka på Björkö utanför Loftahammar. En fantastisk drevjakt på vildsvin o dovhjortar.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drevjakt Med Jompen Och Pierre & Drevjakt Med Filip
programme.desc: Jompen och Pierre åker med gråten i halsen på säsongens sista drevjakt. Grinda bjuder på kron, mufflon, vildsvin mm.
programme.sub-title: Drevjakt Med Jompen Och Pierre & Drevjakt Med Filip

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Spännande Jakt På Viltrika Marker
programme.desc: Jompen och VideoVictor åker till Sörmland för årets bockpremiär. En utmanande jakt samt bygge av ett minst sagt gigantiskt jakttorn.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Pierre Drömmer Sig Iväg, Monteria I Spanien & Jompens Första Monteria
programme.desc: Vi gräver i våra arkiv i väntan på att Jompen ska komma tillbaka från Spanien. Vi hittar Pierre på hans livs bästa andjakt.Han befinner sig på Ericsberg i Sörmland.
programme.sub-title: Pierre Drömmer Sig Iväg, Monteria I Spanien & Jompens Första Monteria

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Sommarens Bästa Vildsvinsjakt & Smygjakt På Dovhjort
programme.desc: Pierre och Kamera-Kalle ger sig ut i spannmålen för att jaga vildsvin. Häng med när naturen bjuder på makalösa upplevelser på viltrika marker.
programme.sub-title: Sommarens Bästa Vildsvinsjakt & Smygjakt På Dovhjort

programme.title: Vilterian: Rådjursspett
programme.desc: Alexander Lundin bjuder Jompen ännu en gång på fantastisk viltmat. Denna vecka blir det rådjursspett med karamelliserade rotfrukter & gräddig lingonsås.

programme.title: Vilterian: Kind
programme.desc: I detta avsnitt besöker Jompen Kim Nyström på Slottsholmen som bjuder på Rödvinsbrässerad vildsvinskind och härliga amuse-bouche rätter.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vassjakt & Drömjakt På Älg

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Robot
programme.desc: Lee Meriwether and Malachi Throne are guest stars in an IMF plot involving doubles and double-dealing, with Paris playing five different roles and Jim Phelps turning magician on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Fool's Gold
programme.desc: Musical comedy star Sally Ann Howes plays a dramatic role as a guest member of the IMF when it sets out to foil a plot to ruin a friendly country with counterfeit money on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Double Circle
programme.desc: Guest star Anne Francis joins the IMF when it sets out to prevent destruction of a secret formula vital to America's missile defense system on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Submarine
programme.desc: To locate a hoard of stolen money, the IMF takes the one man who knows its hiding place (guest star Stephen McNally) on a bizarre submarine voyage on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Brothers
programme.desc: The IMF turns itself into a surgical team to operate on a tyrannical ruler who has imprisoned the rightful king, his twin brother, on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 1)
programme.desc: Guest stars Noel Harrison and Diane Baker are drawn into a daring IMF charade that uses a trained falcon to help in a crown jewel theft in the first of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 2)
programme.desc: Barney is blinded in an accident, a bride-to-be is buried alive and Paris poses as a man he is unaware is marked for death in the second of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Falcon (Part 3)
programme.desc: A trained falcon is summoned in a last-ditch rescue attempt when Jim Phelps finds his IMF endangered by a traitor's assassination plot in the last of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Time Bomb
programme.desc: To head off a threatened atomic blast, Jim Phelps gains entry to a top secret nuclear plant by posing as a temperamental artist with guest star Barbara Luna as his model on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Amnesiac
programme.desc: As a doctor with a startling new treatment for amnesia, Jim Phelps forces Paris to relive another man's past when the IMF pushes a search for stolen nuclear material on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Chico
programme.desc: A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Terror
programme.desc: To calm a Middle East trouble spot, the IMF tries to keep a man in prison long enough to make it look as though he is trying to break out on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Gitano
programme.desc: The IMF hides a young prince from assassins by disguising him as a gypsy girl, then Paris sets out to betray the boy to his pursuers on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hva er merkeligere enn det store hullet som åpner seg i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv. Kjærligheten, virker det som.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 14 år gamle Duncan sliter med å passe inn i sin nye familesituasjon, med mor, hennes nye, nedlatende kjæreste, og hans datter. Mens moren blir stadig mer fraværende finner Duncan en usannsynlig venn i sjefen på badeanlegget hvor han har sommerjobb.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Richard Gere spiller Jack Sommersby, en mann som kommer hjem fra krigen for å gjenoppta livet sitt sju år etter at han ble antatt omkommet.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: På randen til havari i ekteskap og karriere drar den arbeidsløse forfatteren Jack Spencer og hans kone Amanda på ferie. Med en uventet dobbeltbooking blir den private, romantiske luksusen alt annet enn privat og romantisk.

programme.title: Love on Repeat
programme.desc: Amber er nylig separert og mindre av alt. Fast bestemt på at dette er nok, bestemmer hun seg for å finne noe som kan gjøre henne glad igjen.

programme.title: A Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: Når de blir tvunget til å jobbe sammen, lærer to eventarrangører at motsetninger kan skape de mest uventede resultatene. Jessica, en alenemamma og bryllupsfikser - Adam, en rivaliserende festfikser som ikke kan huske det siste bryllupet han var i.

programme.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programme.desc: Vivien og Chloe har nylig arvet sin tante Isabelles bakeri. Chloe ønsker å endre bakeriets utseende og meny, mens Vivien vil beholde alt slik det alltid har vært. Dette fører til en kamp om hvem som kan lokke til seg kunder på stadig mer kreative måter.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: I etterkant av av en verdensomspennende atomkrig er Ann Burden (Margot Robbie) en overlevende. Ann frykter lenge at hun er det eneste gjenlevende mennesket på jorden, inntil hun oppdager noe helt forbløffende: et annen menneske.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars er en elskverdig introvert mann med emosjonell bagasje som har hindret ham i å si ja til livet. Etter år av ensomhet inviterer han Bianca, en venn han har møtt på Internett, til å møte ham. Han introduserer Bianca for sin bror og hans kone...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programme.desc: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programme.desc: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programme.desc: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Distance Call
programme.desc: A toy telephone becomes the link between a young boy and his dead grandmother.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Piano in the House
programme.desc: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit

programme.desc: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programme.desc: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: En voodoo-forbannelse overføre den døende seriemorderen Charles Lee Ray sin sjel til Chucky, en Good Guys-dukke. Den unge Andy får dukken i bursdagsgave, og Chucky gjenopptar snart drapsbølgen sin. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2

programme.desc: Walter, Cabe og Happy er fanget sammen med mannskapet i en topphemmelig ubåt når en eksplosjon sender den til bunnen av havet med begrenset oksygen og en selvdestruksjonsfunksjon som snart vil aktiveres.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Super Fun Guys

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 305

programme.desc: Jonas og Louise får sjokk når de ser hvilke hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen jobber overtid for å prøve å oppfylle parets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia ønsker å flytte litt utenfor byen - men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads sin hjelp kjøper de en bolig som har nøyaktig alt de ikke liker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 401
programme.desc: I første episode møter vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende åtte millioner å kjøpe hus og pusse opp for. Men det store budsjettet har ikke hjulpet dem så langt - kan ekspertene være til hjelp?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 402
programme.desc: Ekspertene drar til Hørning, der presten og hennes familie trenger et nytt sted å bo. De leier et lite rekkehus og nå vil de gjerne flytte.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om å bytte ut sine lille leiebolig på Nørrebro med en murervilla i Hillerød. Men de angrer bittert på at de har spurt ekspertene om hjelp når de får se huset pengene gikk til.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små barn - og en drøm om å bo sammen med besteforeldrene. Så ekspertene leter etter et hus som har plass til to familier, med plass til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke nok plass i den lille Frederiksberg-leiligheten etter en familieøkning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er store, så selv med 7 millioner finner de ikke det de er ute etter.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen faller i bakken med et brak. Ekspertene må jobbe hardt før den lille familien - forhåpentligvis - kan flytte inn i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to barn har tatt over hjemmet, og det er leker overalt. Løsningen er et større hjem, men paret har ikke klart å finne det rette huset enda. Nå får de hjelp av ekspertene, men det blir ikke lett.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte rekkehuset sitt i den tro at de snart skulle finne det rette huset. Men sånn gikk det ikke. Paret er utrolig kresne, og har høye krav. Kan ekspertene skape hjemmet som Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to barn leier i Humlebæk, og de er mildt sagt lei av det. De mangler plass, hage - og de vil også ha barn sammen snart. Men to års husjakt har ikke gitt resultat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en vakker herskapsleilighet på Frederiksberg med sine to barn. Men de vil ha mer plass i et barnevennlig nabolag, innom sykkelavstand fra sentrum. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finne et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Kristian drømmer om en diger garasje, og Nathja vil heller bli i Køge – kan Tobias oppfylle drømmene sine?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.
